name: Safeguard Global
summary: Safeguard Global's Global Pay service covers payroll in 170+ countries, with local experts for compliance and standardized reports for every country and pay run. It publishes no price, and the page sends buyers to a contact form.

facts.text: The Global Pay page title says employees can be paid in 170+ countries, while another line on the same page offers to view all 187 countries.
A section headed local experts, full compliance says the team handles compliance, filings and reports across almost any country.
A section headed consolidated reporting promises standardized payroll outputs and reports for every country and every pay run.
The page names no security certification, no integration partners and no contract terms.

hiddenCosts: No price is published. The page asks buyers to contact the company.
Contract length, setup fees and per-country charges are not stated on the page.
